locator: I.2 n.4 [23500], Unde necesse est ad naturalem rationem recurrere, cui omnes assentire coguntur
interpretation: I.2 n.4: 'quidam eorum, ut Mahumetistae et Pagani, non conveniunt nobiscum in auctoritate alicuius Scripturae ... Unde necesse est ad naturalem rationem recurrere, cui omnes assentire coguntur. Quae tamen in rebus divinis deficiens est.' The limitation ('deficiens') is kept.
attribution: The passage states that against Muslims and pagans, who accept no Scripture, one must have recourse to natural reason, to which all are compelled to assent, though it is deficient in divine matters, which is the premise.
